scenario: String literals per LGRA.15.8 — double-quoted single-line `"..."` and triple-quoted multi-line `"""..."""`. Standard escapes work. Unknown escape is a compile error (LGRA.2.10a). Pin uses both single and a triple-quoted message.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info """line one
line two"""
